tools.name: url-to-markdown
tools.description: Convert a public https URL to markdown ($0.005 USDC via x402). https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects. Returns JSON { url, final_url, title?, content_type, markdown, warnings }. Provided as is, with no warranty or guaran
